explanation: Work on Cologne Cathedral began in 1248 but stalled for centuries, so its spires were finished only in 1880, 21 years after London's Gothic Revival clock tower.

claims.text: The clock tower of London's Palace of Westminster, popularly called Big Ben, was completed in 1859.
Construction of Cologne Cathedral began in 1248, halted in the 15th century and resumed in the 1840s.
The Westminster clock tower is built in the Gothic Revival style; its official name has been Elizabeth Tower since 2012.
